Visually, the bow appears to merge with the hand/fingers, and the finger positioning on the violin neck is ambiguous/non-functional. I agree with the Router's severity ratings. The structural collapse of the primary subject's action (playing violin) is a significant defect (Severity 3), while text issues are moderate (Severity 2).
